description: Participants take over performance reporting for Wadi Noor Transit, a fictional bus operator whose three reports give three different on-time figures. On a synthetic warehouse of trips, boardings and routes they write governed metric definitions, build a semantic model that defines each metric once, design a dashboard for one decision within a load-time budget, trace an anomaly to its source, and test a conversational analytics agent on certified questions with and without the semantic layer. Platform-scale semantic layer design is DS-408.
audience: Practitioners. Data scientists and analysts who have completed the level 200 set or can show equivalent work: an analysis they framed, carried out and explained to a stakeholder.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins, grouping and window functions
Has built a chart-based report for others

outcomes.text: Explain why reports built on one warehouse disagree on the same measure, given three operator reports with different on-time figures
outcomes.evidence: a diagnosis naming the definitional cause of each difference

outcomes.text: Draft metric definitions stating formula, grain, filters, time logic, owner and limits, given twelve business questions and the data dictionary
outcomes.evidence: a metric catalogue that passes a peer checklist and reconciles to source totals

outcomes.text: Implement a star-schema semantic model with a slowly changing route dimension and each metric defined once, given the synthetic transit warehouse
outcomes.evidence: reference values returned for 25 test queries

outcomes.text: Analyse a metric anomaly by drill-down and segmentation to find its source, given a seeded drop in weekly ridership
outcomes.evidence: an anomaly note naming the cause, affected segments and correction

outcomes.text: Design a dashboard for a named audience and decision within a load-time budget, given the operations director's brief and a three-second budget
outcomes.evidence: a dashboard, a one-page rationale and recorded timings, scored on a rubric

outcomes.text: Evaluate a conversational analytics agent against governed metrics and decide which question types it may answer unreviewed, given 40 certified questions and a stated tolerance for wrong figures
outcomes.evidence: a memo with accuracy by question type and configuration, plausible wrong answers and a go or no-go decision
